items.title: N-able Discloses Critical Mail Assure Vulnerability Found During Breach Investigation
items.summary: N-able yesterday disclosed a critical flaw it found while investigating the breach of its Mail Assure and SpamExperts Hosted Cloud, an email filtering service it runs for managed service providers. The bug, tracked as CVE-2026-134624, is a server-side request forgery (SSRF) flaw.
